items.question: Which additional epithets further characterize the deity in this enumerated list of names?
items.inference: These epithets continue the enumeration of the deity's names by attributing contrasting aspects, wisdom, lordship over obstacles, and an elephant face.
uncertainties: Whether durmukho is intended as a fearsome aspect or a distinct name in this context is not explicit.
items.plain_english: He is beautiful-faced, fierce-faced, wise, the king of obstacles, and elephant-faced.
